Document 1: E-mail

To: Elena Marsh, Merchandise Planner, Meridian Home Goods
From: Daniel Okafor, Export Coordinator, Northwind Ceramics
Date: March 3
Subject: Update on Order NC-4821 (Stoneware Dinnerware)

Dear Ms. Marsh,

I am writing to update you on order NC-4821, which was originally scheduled to leave our facility on March 12. Scheduled maintenance on our kiln No. 3 has been extended by six days, so the glazing stage will finish later than planned. We now expect to load the container on March 18, with the vessel departing on March 20 and arriving at the Port of Savannah on April 2.

I understand that your Spring Home Event begins on April 8. To help you meet that date, we can divide the order: the first 1,200 sets can travel by air and arrive on March 28, while the remainder goes by sea. The air freight would add $2,400 to the shipping cost, but Northwind will absorb that charge. Please confirm by March 6 whether you want a split shipment or prefer to wait for the full order. If we do not hear from you by then, we will send everything by sea.

Regards,
Daniel Okafor

Document 2: Internal Memo

To: Distribution and Marketing Teams
From: Elena Marsh, Merchandise Planner
Date: March 5
Subject: Order NC-4821 and the Spring Home Event

I have confirmed with Northwind that we will use the split shipment. The 1,200 sets arriving on March 28 will be sent directly to the five flagship stores that are taking part in the Spring Home Event, which runs from April 8 to April 20. The rest of the order will reach Savannah on April 2, clear customs in two business days, and be trucked to our regional warehouse. Those units should be available for regional stores on April 7.

Because Northwind is covering the air-freight charge, we will not change the retail price of the dinnerware. Marketing should move the online launch from April 8 to April 10 so that regional inventory is in place before customers begin ordering. Please also note that the new pattern has been assigned item code HG-7745; all stores must use this code when scanning the product.

Elena
questionText: What is the purpose of Mr. Okafor's e-mail?

options.text: (A) To explain a change to a delivery schedule
(B) To request payment for an outstanding invoice
(C) To cancel an order that is no longer available
(D) To introduce a new line of stoneware products

translation: Mục đích của e-mail ông Okafor là gì? — Giải thích một thay đổi trong lịch giao hàng của đơn NC-4821.
explanation: Đáp án A. E-mail thông báo đơn NC-4821 sẽ rời cơ sở muộn hơn dự kiến và nêu các mốc mới: đóng container ngày 18/3, tàu khởi hành ngày 20/3, đến Savannah ngày 2/4. B sai vì không có hóa đơn hay yêu cầu thanh toán nào. C sai vì đơn hàng vẫn được thực hiện, chỉ thay đổi cách giao. D sai vì đây là đơn hàng stoneware đã đặt trước, không phải hoạt động giới thiệu sản phẩm mới.

Document 1: Job Posting

Logistics Data Analyst — Beacon Analytics
Location: Columbus, Ohio (hybrid)
Employment type: Full-time

Beacon Analytics is seeking a Logistics Data Analyst to support our growing retail distribution network. The analyst will examine shipment data, build weekly dashboards in Power BI, work with carriers to resolve delivery issues, and prepare monthly reports on transportation costs.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, statistics, or a related field
  • At least two years of experience in logistics, operations, or data analysis
  • Advanced Excel skills
  • Power BI certification preferred
  • Knowledge of SQL is an advantage

The position is hybrid: three days per week at our Columbus office and two days remote. The salary range is $62,000-$70,000 per year. Applications must be submitted by May 15, and the successful candidate will begin on June 2.

Document 2: E-mail

To: Maya Chen
From: Rachel Kim, Talent Acquisition, Beacon Analytics
Date: May 14
Subject: Your application for Logistics Data Analyst

Dear Ms. Chen,

Thank you for applying for the Logistics Data Analyst position on May 9. The hiring committee was impressed by your three years as an operations analyst at Hartwell Freight and by your Power BI certification.

We would like to invite you to a 45-minute video interview on May 21 at 10:00 a.m. with Omar Haddad, our director of logistics. Before the interview, please complete a 30-minute Excel exercise; the link will be active until May 19. Kindly confirm your attendance by May 16. If you need any accommodation for the interview, please contact Human Resources by May 18.

Please note that the first six weeks of the role are an on-site training period, during which you will work at the Columbus office five days a week. After that, you will follow the hybrid schedule described in the job posting.

We look forward to speaking with you.

Sincerely,
Rachel Kim
questionText: What is the main purpose of Ms. Kim's e-mail?

options.text: (A) To offer Ms. Chen the analyst position
(B) To invite Ms. Chen to an interview
(C) To request references from Ms. Chen
(D) To confirm Ms. Chen's first day of work

translation: Mục đích chính trong e-mail của bà Kim là gì? — Mời bà Chen tham gia phỏng vấn.
explanation: Đáp án B. E-mail nêu rõ: “We would like to invite you to a 45-minute video interview on May 21”. A sai vì thư chỉ mời phỏng vấn, chưa đưa ra lời đề nghị việc làm. C sai vì không yêu cầu người giới thiệu. D sai vì ngày 2/6 là ngày bắt đầu làm việc được nêu trong tin tuyển dụng, không phải nội dung xác nhận của e-mail này.

vocab.meaning: sự hỗ trợ, điều chỉnh cần thiết

Beginning Monday, September 22, the Cedar Falls Plant will conduct a two-week trial run of the newly installed Automated Packaging Line 4. During the trial period, Line 4 will operate for one shift per day while our engineering team monitors output speed and carton-sealing quality.

Operators currently assigned to Line 2 will rotate onto Line 4 in teams of six according to the schedule posted outside the supervisor's office. Please review the attached specification table and training memorandum for daily operating hours, production targets, and mandatory safety requirements.

— Luis Ortega, Plant Manager

Quality Approval StandardFewer than 15 defective cartons per 10,000 unitsRequired to approve second shift in November

MEMORANDUM
To: Line 2 Packaging Operators
From: Safety & Training Office
Date: September 15
Subject: Mandatory Line 4 Orientation
